findings.reason: the mechanism picks the wrong record and a node built from it would report a promotion comment as the section's closing note; the plan must select the closing comment by a reserved id rather than by recency.
findings.text: section 3 says a ticked entry carries "the newest comment on that section, which is the landing beat's closing record", but promotion appends its own section comments after the close, so the newest comment is often a review or a "landing:" line and the selected record is not the closing record

findings.reason: a negative control that passes on the unfixed code measures nothing; the node must declare a mutation (a digest with declarations folded in) to falsify it, or drop the assertion.
findings.text: section 3 claims both of its tests fail on the current code "which has no todos field", but the second test only ticks a declaration and checks the review fingerprint, and plan_fingerprint strips declarations (plan_review._digest_state) with _without_section_declarations already present per section 2, so that test passes on the unfixed code
